polishes.name: Custom
polishes.collection: If you are wanting to do a custom
polishes.description: Do you have a mani itch that you can't find the color to itch? Fret no more! You can order a custom made polish through Artie Mae! When you checkout, leave in the comments your inspo or vibes you are going for. You can also email artiemaepolish@gmail.com with your order number to include photos if you'd like. Artie Mae will reach out within the current TAT to further discuss the polish and create prototypes. Once a final formula has been agreed upon, a full sized (15 mL) bottle will me made just for you! If you are wanting to do a custom collection, you must purchase a custom polish for EACH different polish. You may also order multiples of one custom formula for a discounted price of $13.50 for each additional bottle.

polishes.name: Peel-anator
polishes.description: Peel-anator is a water based base coat that is designed to come off your nails easily. This is best used using the "moat" method (see below for details). Moat method: Put Peel-anator in the center of your nail and let dry completely. Do not go allthe way to the edge with Peel-anator. Then, go over Peel-anator with our PVB free base coat, Stay-anator, and make sure to cover the whole nail as normal. Finish your manicure and you're good to go!

polishes.name: Plumpify Quick Dry Top Coat

polishes.name: Smoothify Glitter Grabber
polishes.description: Smoothify is a glitter grabber that is intended to be used between your color and your top coat to help smooth out bumps from more textured polishes. Allow your color to dry for a few minutes, then apply a thick layer of Smoothify. Allow Smoothify 5-10 minutes to dry and get into the nooks and crannies caused by glitters and grittier pigments. Then, finish your mani with one of our quick dry top coats.
